checks.evidence: Recovery using two recovery codes from different methods, step 4: both codes verified and recovery completes.
Recovery using one recovery code and bound single-factor authenticator, step 4: authenticator verified as bound and recovery completes.
Recovery using repeated identity proofing, step 3: identity proofing verified and recovery completes without any recovery code.

Recovery failure with two recovery codes from the same method, step 3: attempt rejected. This covers the same-method variant of the check. Single-code-only with no bound authenticator is not tested separately.

invented: Preconditions name 'recovery contact' as a recovery code method, but the requirement does not state it.
The system is assumed to present a menu of recovery options and to prompt for codes in a fixed order.
TOTP app or SMS is named as an example of a single-factor authenticator.
The identity-proofing test assumes the account was previously identity-proofed.
